name: Haigh
blurb: Ten minutes south into Barnsley. We pick up a lot of Haigh customers — easy run up the lanes to our place.
metaDescription: Dog grooming near Haigh — a 10-minute drive up the lanes to Keith's K9 Care home salon in Hall Green, Wakefield WF4. One dog at a time. Book your dog in.
lead: A short run north up the lanes from Haigh, Keith's K9 Care is a calm, one-to-one home dog grooming salon — and we pick up plenty of Haigh customers.
body: Haigh sits just over the boundary into Barnsley (S75), and it's an easy ten-minute run up the lanes to us in Hall Green. We pick up a lot of Haigh dogs — far enough out that a quiet, one-to-one groom is a welcome change, close enough that it's no trek. Easy parking right outside on Castle Meadows, too.

Keith's K9 Care is a home salon, built around one dog at a time. A quiet, purpose-built room, no kennels, no shared dryers, no other dogs barking — just your dog and Keith. It's a calm setup that suits nervous dogs, puppies and older dogs, and it means your dog has Keith's undivided attention throughout.

Keith is IPET-qualified and grooms every coat type and breed — full grooms, puppy first grooms, bath and tidy, nail trims, de-matting and traditional hand stripping. Prices are published in full with breed examples, and confirmed in person before he starts, so the short drive is the only difference — never the bill.
Booking your Haigh dog in is a quick call, WhatsApp or message. Keith likes a quick chat about coat, age and temperament first so the right amount of time is set aside.

faqs.q: How far is the salon from Haigh?
faqs.a: About 4 miles — a ten-minute drive north up the lanes to Castle Meadows in Hall Green (WF4).

faqs.q: I'm just into Barnsley (S75) — do you cover Haigh?
faqs.a: Yes — Haigh is well within our patch and we groom a lot of Haigh dogs. It's a short, easy run up the lanes.
In full, with breed-by-breed examples on the pricing page. No ringing round for a quote — Keith confirms the exact figure in person before he starts.

faqs.q: What are your opening hours for Haigh?
faqs.a: Keith grooms Tuesday to Friday, 9am to 5pm, and Saturday mornings until 2pm, closed Sundays and Mondays. Haigh is a ten-minute run north up the lanes, and the hours flex around your appointment. Call or message 07926 471552 to find a time that suits.

faqs.q: Do you groom doodles and spaniels from Haigh?
faqs.a: Yes, doodles, spaniels and every coat type are welcome, and Keith is IPET-qualified across all breeds. The poodle crosses in particular do well on a regular six-week groom to keep mats at bay. Let him know the breed and coat when you book.

faqs.q: Do you groom nervous or rescue dogs from Haigh?
faqs.a: Yes, the calm one-to-one home salon suits nervous and rescue dogs well, with no other dogs around and no rush. Keith works at the dog's pace and takes breaks whenever they are needed. Tell him the background when you book so he can take it gently.
